guide.summary: Internal or personal use, any scopes (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none); Public agent, sensitive scopes only (app review); Public agent, restricted scopes (read mail) (app review, wait several weeks); Workspace Marketplace public listing (app review).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Internal or personal use, any scopes (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Public agent, restricted scopes (read mail) (app review, wait several weeks).

composio.note: Composio provides a managed Gmail OAuth app. Use a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret for your own branding, wider scopes or dedicated quota.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype: Composio's managed Gmail app works. For launch you usually need your own app to show your brand, request scopes Composio's defaults lack, and get a dedicated quota.
reasons: Consent screen shows 'Composio wants to access your account' with the managed app
Composio's default scopes may not include everything you need
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users; your own app gets a dedicated quota
Managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum trigger polling interval

prerequisites.title: Google Cloud project
prerequisites.detail: Create a project, configure the OAuth consent screen and declare all scopes on the Data Access page.

prerequisites.title: Public website and privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: You need a publicly accessible home page and a privacy policy on the same domain, linked from the consent screen. You must also verify the domain in Google Search Console.

prerequisites.title: Test account for reviewers
prerequisites.detail: Marketplace reviewers need a test account on your system if your app has user or paid features.

steps.title: Create auth config in Composio (managed)
steps.detail: For a prototype, use Composio's managed Gmail app through the API. No Google setup is needed.
steps.done_when: A test user can connect Gmail.

steps.title: Create Google Cloud project and OAuth client
steps.detail: Log in to Google Cloud, create the project and an OAuth client, and set the redirect URI copied from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Draft scope list and justifications
steps.detail: Pick the narrowest scopes and write why broader ones are not enough. For sending only, avoid full-access scopes.
steps.done_when: Each scope is tied to a feature.

steps.title: Publish branding and verify domain
steps.detail: Enter app name, logo and contact on the Branding page, verify authorized domains, then click Verify Branding.

steps.title: Prepare demo video script
steps.detail: Write a script showing the English consent flow, app name, client ID in the address bar and each scope's feature.

steps.title: Record and submit verification
steps.detail: Record the video and submit the verification request.

steps.title: Complete security assessment
steps.detail: Hire a Google-approved assessor to review how your servers handle restricted data.

steps.title: Wait for Google verification
steps.detail: Google reviews brand and scopes. Fix any issues and resubmit.

steps.title: Submit Marketplace listing
steps.detail: Enable the Marketplace SDK, create the store listing, and submit for review. Choose public or private carefully.

steps.title: Wait for Marketplace review
steps.detail: Fix issues and resubmit if sent back.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config with your app
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Connections use your app's consent screen.

traps.title: A rate limit quota increase request is expected to
traps.detail: A rate limit quota increase request is expected to get a response in 5 business days.

traps.title: Restricted scopes need security assessment
traps.detail: Apps accessing restricted data through a third-party server need an annual assessment by a Google-approved third party. Most Gmail read scopes are restricted.

traps.title: Unverified apps hit user caps
traps.detail: Until verified, a user cap applies, a warning screen shows and refresh token life is limited. The rate limit also applies to verified apps.

traps.title: Wrong consent screen settings fail review
traps.detail: Marketplace review fails if user type is Internal or publishing status is Testing.

traps.title: Branding is locked during review
traps.detail: You cannot change branding while verification is in progress. Brand check results expire after 7 days.

traps.title: Marketplace audience is permanent
traps.detail: After publishing as public or private you cannot change it.

traps.title: Callback domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: Google verifies authorized domains, but Composio's callback domain cannot be verified by you. Proxy the redirect through your own domain and register that endpoint as the redirect URI.

traps.title: Possible future API charges
traps.detail: Gmail API use is free now, but exceeding quota limits is planned to incur charges later in 2026. The daily threshold is 80,000,000 units per project.

blockers.what_it_means: The app is exceeding its new user authorization rate limit.
blockers.what_to_do: Check the grant rate on the OAuth consent screen page, then request a quota increase; expect a response in 5 business days.

blockers.what_it_means: The app is not verified yet.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a verification request to remove it.
blockers.agent_can_help: Prepare the scope justifications and demo script.

blockers.what_to_do: Fix the issues or request a manual review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Check the home page and privacy policy against the requirements.

open_questions: How long does verification for sensitive-only scopes take? No time was found; check recent reports on the Google developer forums or ask Google support.
Which Gmail scopes are covered by the Marketplace-only requirement? Check whether a plain OAuth app needs a Marketplace listing (the docs suggest it does not); confirm with Google support.
What is the new user cap number for unverified apps? Check the Unverified apps page.
